a.d: In Ubatuba’s beach market, vendors ask your color preference. Colors: azul, verde, vermelho, amarelo, preto, branco, rosa, laranja. Comparatives: “maior”, “menor”, “mais caro”, “mais barato”. False friend: “rosa” is both pink and rose.

a.d: In Ponta Grossa, Sunday is for family: lunch, park and a nap. Express shared plans: “A gente vai…”. Note that “a gente” (lit. the people) is the casual form of “nós”. False friend: “domingo” (Sunday) vs “dominar” (to dominate).
